name: adminToken
label: Admin API token
placeholder: Enter an organization or admin API token
help: Used to list the projects in your organization. Use an organization token or a personal token from an admin account. Create tokens in [sanity.io/manage](https://www.sanity.io/manage) → your project → API → Tokens.

name: projects
label: Project API tokens
help: For each Sanity project you want to query, add its **Project ID** and a project API token (Viewer role). The Project ID is shown on the project page in [sanity.io/manage](https://www.sanity.io/manage); create a token under that project's API → Tokens. Datasets, members and content tiles only work for projects listed here.

name: apiVersion
label: Content API version
help: Advanced: the dated Sanity API version used for GROQ queries. Leave as the default unless you need a specific version.
